Verification at updated tip: The self-transfer leaves 8 L at 8 L. A preceding increment in the same stage survives.
Port implications: Conservation works for the original alias case.

Verification at updated tip: A child argument or initializer failure rolls back the parent’s writes and already queued sibling. An independent earlier commit survives.
Port implications: The original atomic-stage case passes.

Verification at updated tip: Replacing uniform(0, 2) with uniform(10, 12) gives 11 for the immediate median draw and mean. Replacing it twice and reading its standard deviation also work.
Port implications: The stage reads its latest assignment.

Verification at updated tip: Successive after stages at 0.1 h and 0.2 h now settle inclusively and in creation order. A trigger first firing at 0.1 h and resetting after 0.1 h fires only twice at a 0.3 h horizon. With a longer horizon its third firing occurs at 0.30000000000000004 h.
Port implications: Periodic events at the cutoff can be omitted.

Verification at updated tip: The full A and B tank chain passes 1 L/h, including correct behavior with a closed middle valve. Adding a return connection B to A with zero request and zero hard capacity stops it at setup with a full-store ring diagnostic.
Port implications: A valve physically incapable of flow can prevent an otherwise feasible run.

Verification at updated tip: Single-pipe small/near-cap/idle cases pass. The solver meets a tank’s 0.0000005 L/h request through two pipes, but final rounding erases both shares. In a second case it takes a feasible top-ranked normalized loss of 0 and publishes a loss of 1.
Port implications: Reported rates can discard the solver’s actual optimum. Equivalent L, mL and kL examples all reproduce the two-pipe finding.

Verification at updated tip: The two-junction feed-only case preserves 1/2, 1/4, 1/4 and naming all relevant flows gives thirds. At a hospital-first outlet supplying 1 L/h, naming just the garden flow with no objective gives hospital/garden 0/1 instead of 1/0. Naming both restores 1/0.
Port implications: Naming one flow still silently displaces an unnamed consumer’s explicit endpoint priority. Relevant to any port that combines priorities with a solver.

Area: Flow evidence depends on selected histories
Verification at updated tip: Tank remains at 5 kL at hour 2. With rate history the report says the pipe moved material. Without that history it now says the rate was not recorded.
Port implications: The report no longer claims that an unrecorded flow moved nothing.

Verification at updated tip: An edit lowering the tally now invalidates its numeric alias’s lag too. Enabling a previously unreachable withdrawal by editing a Boolean still leaves the stock and its alias certified never to fall. The event ran and the stock went from 11.99 to 9 L.
Port implications: Reporting after an intervention can certify a false invariant and say an event in the trace cannot start.

Verification at updated tip: Low-level reads return unavailable beyond both pause and failure. The report on a run stopped at hour 2 still assigns a valid hour-1 value to hour 3 and unavailable to hour 1 when the caller requests [3,1].
Port implications: Callers that request times out of order can display observations under the wrong times.

Verification at updated tip: After an external edit of -1 L, recording the stock alone reports zero on its external ledger. Recording only the ledger raises LookupError. Keeping both yields -1 L. Prepopulating the cache with the full run changes the stock-only answer from zero to -1 L.
Port implications: A material balance can depend on what was recorded or cached on a previous run.

Verification at updated tip: 8 h in [6 h, 1 day] is now admitted and reversed compatible bounds are rejected. The equivalent closed singleton 0.1 day in [2.4 h,2.4 h] still fails, as does a physically equal pair of endpoints with mixed decimal spellings. A reversed interval in a membership predicate returns false.
Port implications: Some physically equivalent numeric declarations still disagree. No exact affected singleton was identified in the saved catalogue drafts.

Verification at updated tip: Invalid numeric distribution parameters, including overrides, are rejected. A valid normal(0,1,9,10) still draws 9.07578 in median mode, but reading its mean or standard deviation fails the run at setup with division by zero.
Port implications: No reference to these moment properties was identified in the saved catalogue drafts. The library contract is still incomplete.

Verification at updated tip: Reading a field through a saved occurrence reference still fails compilation. An entity formula capturing an invocation local still compiles and remains readable after the invocation ends. A captured scalar works.
Port implications: Both lifetime directions still diverge from the specification.

Verification at updated tip: The original tree returns leaf/top 1/2 and 4/5 after an option change. A real cycle names the offending chain. None of the 16 water variants now report the template cycle. A fixed <leaf,top>.at(0) lookup that selects only leaf can still be treated as a self-edge on top. Reading a total through 100 acyclic child links also raised RecursionError.
Port implications: The original water-type blockage is removed. Keyed recursion and long acyclic chains have separate limits.

Verification at updated tip: An input declared as 99 h citing a 34 h library datum still compiles with no diagnostic.
Port implications: Known validation gap explicitly listed for later consideration.

Verification at updated tip: With a one-piece budget, full recording returns 12 pieces at a pause and 20 at completion. Stock-only recording returns 2 and 3 respectively. All succeed.
Port implications: The public recording budget does not cap large histories.

Port implications: Eligibility for reporting lag still needs a numeric type check.
